''' Disasters and accidents '''

**At least five people are killed, nineteen others are injured and six are reported missing after an explosion at a [[chemical plant]] in [[Gaomi]], [[Shandong]], [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/emerging/large-blast-hits-chemical-plant-chinas-shandong-2025-05-27/ (Reuters)]

**[[Department of Health and Human Services]] secretary [[Robert F. '''International relations''' 
*[[Accession of Timor-Leste to ASEAN]]
**[[Malaysia]]n [[Prime Minister of Malaysia|prime minister]] [[Anwar Ibrahim]], chair of the [[ASEAN]], announces that [[Timor-Leste]] will officially join the ASEAN as its 11th [[Member states of ASEAN|member state]] in October. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/timor-leste-to-be-granted-full-asean-membership-in-oct-2025-pm-anwar (''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Argentine president]] [[Javier Milei]] ratifies [[Argentina]]'s withdrawal from the [[World Health Organization]]. [https://www-theguardian-com.translate.goog/world/2025/may/27/argentina-who-rfk-jr?_x_tr_sl=auto&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en-US (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**[[South Korea]]n authorities announce [[travel ban]]s on former acting [[President of South Korea|presidents]] [[Han Duck-soo]] and [[Choi Sang-mok]], as they are investigated for [[insurrection]] along with former president [[Yoon Suk Yeol]], who is already indicted. [https://www.macaubusiness.com/seoul-slaps-travel-bans-on-two-former-acting-presidents-yonhap/ (Macau Business)]
*[[Capital punishment in Vietnam]]
**The [[National Assembly of Vietnam]] begins deliberations on a [[Vietnamese government|government]] proposal to end the [[death penalty]] for some offences, including [[drug trafficking]] and some national security crimes, replacing them with [[life in prison without parole]]. [https://vietnamnews.vn/politics-laws/1718453/national-assembly-debates-proposal-to-end-death-penalty-for-transport-of-illegal-drugs.html (Vietnam News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 royal tour of Canada]]
**[[Charles III|King Charles III]], in his capacity as [[Monarchy of Canada|King of Canada]], visits [[Canada]] along with [[Queen Camilla]] on [[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] [[Mark Carney]]'s advice. He also read the [[Speech from the Throne]], the first reigning monarch to do so since 1977. [https://www.npr.org/2025/05/26/g-s1-68959/canada-king-charles (NPR)]
*[[2025 Samoan general election]]
**[[Samoa]]n [[Prime Minister of Samoa|prime minister]] [[Fiamē Naomi Mataʻafa]] says that she will dissolve [[Parliament of Samoa|parliament]] and seek an [[early election]] after leading a [[minority government]] since January, when she was expelled from her party. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/562255/samoa-to-go-to-early-election-after-fiame-concedes (RNZ)]
